propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Deus, qui nos beati Pauli Confessoris tui annua solemnitate laetificas:
concede propitius; ut, cujus natalicia colimus, etiam actiones imitemur. Per
Dominum.

translations.caution:

Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.
